title: Stars, jumping mounts and quiet roads
text:
Upgrades show as gold stars, mounts can jump, monsters well below your level leave you alone, and music stays in town.

⬆️ Ordinary monsters 3 or more levels below you no longer attack on sight. They still fight back if you attack them, and elites and bosses still attack whoever comes close
✨ Mounts can jump (Space) and leap over fences and small rocks. Mountain walls and the edge of the world still stop you
⬆️ Upgraded gear shows a gold star for every upgrade rank (up to seven), on its icon, beside its name and in its tooltip
🔧 Music no longer follows you out of town. Towns have their music, the open world has wind, water and birds, and battle music still plays in every fight. Dungeons keep their own eerie score
🔧 Garrick's forge in Brinehaven is named correctly, and the forge tells you the new star rank after each upgrade
